metrics.source_reference: Calculated from CBU official USD rates: 11846.57 on 2026-10-09 and 11813.21 on 2026-09-09. Requested dates: latest 2026-10-09, prior-month 2026-09-09.
caveats: Latest observation: requested 2026-10-09; actual CBU date/rate 2026-10-09, 11846.57 UZS per USD.
Prior-month comparison observation: requested 2026-09-09; actual CBU date/rate 2026-09-09, 11813.21 UZS per USD.
Prior-year comparison observation: requested 2025-10-09; actual CBU date/rate 2025-10-09, 12072.03 UZS per USD.
Formula: ((latest - comparison) / comparison) * 100.
Rounded to 2 decimal places.
Positive means USD/UZS is higher, i.e. UZS depreciation against USD; negative means USD/UZS is lower, i.e. UZS appreciation against USD.
